##### Project general facts

Welcome to Alana by Emaar, an exquisite offering of premium waterfront twin villas that redefine luxury living in Dubai. Nestled amidst pristine waterways that gracefully weave through lush landscapes, Alana is a vision of grandeur, greenery, and pure gorgeousness.

Alana presents a selection of premium waterfront townhouses featuring two distinctive architectural facades - Sierra and Lilac. These homes embody a harmonious blend of contemporary design, urban sophistication, and stylish finishes that will leave you spellbound.

Experience the epitome of modern living in these stunning villas, where every detail has been meticulously crafted to provide the perfect synergy of comfort and elegance. Alana by Emaar is not just a home; it's a lifestyle, a testament to the art of fine living in a serene waterfront setting.

##### Location description and benefits

The Valley Dubai is an expansive residential community located in the heart of Dubai. It is a master-planned development that offers a harmonious blend of nature and modern living. Nestled within the picturesque surroundings of Dubailand, The Valley aims to provide residents with a serene and tranquil lifestyle while still being close to the city's urban amenities.   
  
The Valley also boasts an array of amenities and facilities to cater to the needs of its residents. These include community centers, swimming pools, playgrounds, sports courts, jogging tracks, cycling paths, and barbecue areas. The development also features retail outlets, dining options, and entertainment venues, ensuring that residents have easy access to daily conveniences.   
  
One of the highlights of The Valley is its stunning central park, which serves as the heart of the community. This expansive green space offers a variety of recreational activities, including picnicking areas, walking trails, and open-air fitness zones. It provides an ideal setting for residents to connect with nature and enjoy outdoor activities.   
  
In terms of location, The Valley benefits from its proximity to key areas of Dubai. It is conveniently located near major highways, making it easily accessible from other parts of the city. Residents can enjoy the tranquility of suburban living while being just a short drive away from Dubai's bustling urban centers, business districts, shopping malls, and entertainment hubs. compared to the more bustling tourist hubs on Phuket. It's a good choice for travelers looking for a quieter, more traditional Thai beach experience and access to water-based activities.
